interpretation: Normal local Xorg and freshly obtained Xvfb cannot open their local listeners. A private Wayland compositor cannot bind its display socket. The accessibility bus does not start. This prevents a locally attached graphical Chromium/assistive-technology session for the native printing and speech checks. Existing isolated headless and accessibility-tree evidence is separate.
